Re-checked 2026-09-28 (AgentArts 计费说明 v04, 2026-09-28): the only sandbox billing items are CPU (1 CU per vCPU-h) and memory (0.1 CU per GiB-h) for runtime, code interpreter and browser tool; disk/storage is not a billing item, so disk_gib_month=0 (sandbox disk size itself is unpublished). No snapshot or public-network egress item is listed; both stay null (unknown).

Mainland-China console (support.huaweicloud.com, CNY); every feature is labelled 公测 (public beta) on the release-notes page. No SSH is documented (session API only) and the browser tool offers LiveView of the browser via noVNC, not a full desktop: ssh=false, desktop=false.
